regions.title: Eight-way TPT coefficient builder
regions.confidence: exact-source instruction-verified local relationships; runtime unverified
regions.equation: A=10^(gain_dB/40); g=tan(pi*f/Fs), k=1/max(Q,.025). Numeric modes 0 highpass, 1 bell (k=k/A), 2 low shelf (g=g/sqrt(A)), 3 high shelf (g=g*sqrt(A)), 4 notch, 5 bandpass, 6 lowpass, 7 allpass. Coefficient mixer and integrator math documented in report; GUI mapping not established.

regions.title: Suite EQ mono TPT sample consumer
regions.confidence: exact-source instruction-verified local relationships; runtime unverified
regions.equation: v3=x-s2; v1=a1*s1+a2*v3; v2=s2+a2*s1+a3*v3; s1_next=2*v1-s1; s2_next=2*v2-s2; y=m0*x+m1*v1+m2*v2. Mono TPT branch; other cascades remain.

regions.title: Gate high-pass and stereo-linked absolute envelope
regions.confidence: exact-source instruction-verified local relationships; runtime unverified
regions.equation: hp=a*(x-x_prev+hp_prev); p=max_channel(abs(hp)); E+=alpha_attack_or_release*(p-E); level=max(-120,20log10(E)). Detector filtered, main audio multiplied separately.

regions.title: Gate hysteresis, hold and gain smoothing
regions.confidence: exact-source instruction-verified local relationships; runtime unverified
regions.equation: Open when detector level > T, reload hold; below close threshold decrement hold then close. When closed, gain_dB=max(floor,(level-T)*(ratio-1)); when open, 0 dB. Linear gain uses separate rising/falling smoothing. Close threshold optionally T-4 dB; native setup mapping and runtime not fully established.

regions.title: Limiter three 12-tap fractional-phase peak candidates
regions.confidence: exact-source instruction-verified local relationships; runtime unverified
regions.equation: In enabled branch, three 12-coefficient dot products at 0x2a0/0x2d0/0x300 on channel history; maximum of absolute values and prior peak. Exact fractional-phase positions and true-peak compliance not established.

regions.title: Monotonic peak queue and soft-knee target
regions.confidence: exact-source instruction-verified local relationships; runtime unverified
regions.equation: Timestamped monotonic peak queue expires entries older than lookahead interval. Excess u=peak_dB-ceiling_dB. For half-knee h>0 and -h<u<h, target GR=(u+h)^2/(4h); otherwise max(u,0).

regions.title: Delayed gain and final sample ceiling
regions.confidence: exact-source instruction-verified local relationships; runtime unverified
regions.equation: y=clamp(delayed_audio*linear_gain,-ceiling_linear,ceiling_linear). Sample ceiling is not a certified intersample bound.

regions.title: Mid/side width with interpolated decorrelation and optional DC/high-pass recurrence
regions.confidence: exact-source instruction-verified local relationships; runtime unverified
regions.equation: S=width*((L-R)/2 + d*(tapA-tapB)/2), optional first-order high-pass/DC recurrence on S; L_out=M+S,R_out=M-S. Two interpolated history taps. Mid history write at 0x5d5d3f; exact knob mappings remain.

regions.title: Stereo fractional delay interpolation and feedback routing
regions.confidence: exact-source instruction-verified local relationships; runtime unverified
regions.equation: Linear fractional ring read d=(1-t)*buf[i]+t*buf[i+1] per channel; two first-order smoothing stages in feedback path and selectable cross-channel versus ordinary write routing. Full coefficient/control mapping unresolved.

regions.title: Eight indexed modulated reverb lanes and bounded coloration
regions.confidence: exact-source instruction-verified local relationships; runtime unverified
regions.equation: Modulated fractional delay taps, per-lane two-state damping, optional tanh normalization. Unrolled pair loop covers eight lane indices. Full feedback matrix and decay mapping not yet proven.
